long_biography.plain_text:
Dealership entrepreneur Brian Dennis used property transactions to finance business acquisitions. With advice from Ascension Advisory, he arranged to sell an acquired dealership's real estate and lease it back, using the proceeds to cover the purchase. He repeated this approach across several deals.

Dennis also offered employees university study as a way to retain staff and develop their skills. His dealerships joined a programme providing online Strayer University courses with tuition, fees and books covered. Employees studied outside working hours. His human-resources director enrolled for a master's degree, while an administrative assistant pursued an associate degree in business administration.
